plan.earlySupporterThanks: Early Supporter, thank you for being here first

restore.heading: Restore purchases
restore.body: Bought Pro or storage through the store and it isn't showing? Restore fetches your purchases from your store account and unlocks them again - after a reinstall or on a new device.
restore.restored: Purchases restored. Everything you own is unlocked again.
restore.none: No purchases found for this store account.
restore.notApplied: A purchase was found, but it belongs to a different account. Sign in with the recovery phrase you were using when you bought it.
restore.error: Could not reach the store. Please try again in a moment.

storage.addonFileSizePerk: Bonus: any add-on lifts your file size limit from 50 MB to 100 MB.
storage.upgradeCharge: You're charged {{amount}} today for the rest of your current year. After that it renews at {{price}}/year.
storage.upgradeChargeUntil: You're charged {{amount}} today for the rest of your current year, until {{date}}. After that it renews at {{price}}/year.
storage.upgradeChargeApple: You're charged {{price}} today. Apple refunds the unused part of your current year automatically, and your new year starts now.
storage.cancelScheduled: Storage will be cancelled at the end of your billing period.
storage.cancelConfirm: Cancel your storage add-on? Your extra space stays until the end of the period you already paid for.
storage.legalNote: Storage add-ons are yearly subscriptions and renew automatically until cancelled.
storage.proSpacePitch: You're on the free plan. Pro comes with 500 MB built in, ten times the room you have now.

revoke.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
revoke.bodySelf: This will reset your device registration. Your session stays active. The device re-registers itself immediately.
revoke.bodyOther: All sessions on this device will be signed out.
revoke.freeNote: The slot is freed immediately - you can add a replacement device right away. The removed device stays visible under “Recently removed” for 72 hours.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.modeDesc: Auto follows your system light and dark setting.
appearance.viewDesc: How items are laid out. Auto follows your screen width.
appearance.editorDesc: How notes render while you write.
appearance.faviconsDesc: Site logos next to links and vault logins.
appearance.faviconsProxy: Loads through our proxy. This device only.
appearance.invisiblesDesc: Show spaces, line breaks and paragraph marks while you write.
appearance.sidebarDesc: Which views appear in the sidebar, and which items the All list holds.
appearance.textSizeDesc: Size of your writing. This device only.
appearance.contentWidthDesc: How wide a note runs on screen. This device only.
appearance.spellCheckDesc: PrivacyNotes has no spell checker. Your device adds the red underlines and picks their language. Turn them off if it is not the one you write in. This device only.

journals.applyNote: New entries only. Titles you already have stay as they are.

conflict.title: Sync conflict
conflict.explanation: This note was edited on another device while you had unsaved changes here. We'll use the newer version (from the other device, {{date}}).

danger.heading: Danger zone
danger.warning: This is permanent and cannot be undone. Your encryption key lives only in your recovery phrase. Once server data is deleted, there is no way to recover it.
danger.blockedByStorage: You have an active storage subscription. Cancel it from Storage in settings before you can delete your account.
danger.localDesc: Wipes notes, images, and cached data from this device. This does not delete your account, it only cleans up this browser.
danger.cloudDesc: Permanently removes all synced notes, images, devices, settings, and your account from the server. You can sign up again afterward.
danger.noSession: No active session. Try signing in again.
danger.deleteTimeout: Account deletion timed out. Please try again.
danger.activeSubError: You have an active storage subscription. Cancel it from Storage in settings first, then try again.
